```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Very Important Packages
library(dplyr)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Data Understanding

### Part 1: Just Pharmac Data

```{r}
pharmac <- read.csv("Data_ByTG2_Regional.csv", header = TRUE)
head(pharmac)

# We can remove variables Type, TG2ID, and NHI Completeness
# Type and NHI Completeness only contain one unique variable, 
# and TG2ID is a less informative repeat of TherapeuticGroup2
```

```{r}
drops <- c("Type", "TG2ID", "NHIComp")
pharmac <- pharmac[ , !(names(pharmac) %in% drops)]

pharmac$TherapeuticGrp2 <- as.factor(pharmac$TherapeuticGrp2)
pharmac$District <- as.factor(pharmac$District)

head(pharmac)
```

```{r}
dim(pharmac)
# 12396 observations with 5 variables
```

```{r}
summary(pharmac)
# We can see NumDisp and NumPpl are characters when we want them to be numeric ints
# This is because observations with counts less than 6 are noted as <6
# to protect the anonymity of patients receiving less commonly prescribed medications
# We will have to deal with this.
```

```{r}
# No missing data!
any(is.na(pharmac))
```

```{r}
# Shape and Structure of <6 observations
pharmacSuppressed <- pharmac %>% filter(NumDisps == "<6" | NumPpl == "<6")
head(pharmacSuppressed)
```

```{r}
dim(pharmacSuppressed)
# 524 suppressed observations
```

```{r}
summary(pharmacSuppressed)
```

```{r}
# TG2 pharamaceuticals with most commonly suppressed observations
topSuppressed <- pharmacSuppressed %>%
  count(TherapeuticGrp2, sort = TRUE, name = "TG2_count") %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10)

print(topSuppressed)
```

```{r}
# Districts with most commonly suppressed observations
topSuppressed <- pharmacSuppressed %>%
  count(District, sort = TRUE, name = "District_count") %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10)

print(topSuppressed)
```

```{r}
# Now that we've identified rows with <6 observations, we can remove these rows
# from the working dataset and convert NumPpl and NumDisps to int

pharmac <- pharmac %>%
  filter(NumDisps != "<6", NumPpl != "<6") %>%
  
  mutate(
    across(c(NumDisps, NumPpl), as.numeric)
  )
```

```{r}
# Yahoo!!
summary(pharmac)
```

```{r}
pharmacCorr <- pharmac %>%
  mutate(
    dispensings_per_patient = NumDisps / NumPpl
  )
```

```{r}
summary(pharmacCorr$dispensings_per_patient)
```

```{r}
ggplot(pharmacCorr, aes(x = dispensings_per_patient)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
pharmacCorr %>%
  group_by(TherapeuticGrp2) %>%
  summarise(
    median_dispensings_per_patient =
      median(dispensings_per_patient, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  slice_max(median_dispensings_per_patient, n = 15)
```

```{r}
pharmacCorr %>%
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(NumPpl, NumDisps, use = "complete.obs")
  )

# Surprise, highly correlated
```

```{r}
ggplot(pharmacCorr, aes(x = NumPpl, y = NumDisps)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.15) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Patients vs Dispensings",
    x = "Patients",
    y = "Dispensings"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# NumPpl and NumDisps are expected to be strongly positively associated because more patients generally generate more dispensings
```

```{r}
# Now we actually need to do EDA...
# First correlation plot. Only 2 numeric variables and they should correlate with eachother very strongly due to multicollinearity 

```

```{r}
pharmacNZ <- pharmac %>% filter(District == "New Zealand")

ggplot(pharmacNZ, aes(x=NumPpl, y=District)) + geom_boxplot() + theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5))
```

```{r}
# New Zealand totals per year
ggplot(pharmacNZ, aes(x = factor(YearDisp), y = NumPpl)) +

    x = "Year",

```

```{r}
pharmacDistrict <- pharmac %>% filter(District != "New Zealand")

ggplot(pharmacDistrict, aes(x = reorder(District, NumPpl, median), y = NumPpl)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    x = "District",
    y = "Patients (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(pharmacDistrict, aes(x = reorder(District, NumPpl, median), y = NumPpl)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ YearDisp) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    x = "District",
    y = "Patients (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
pharmacDistrict %>%
  group_by(District, YearDisp) %>%
  summarise(
    patients = sum(NumPpl),
    dispensings = sum(NumDisps),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = YearDisp, y = patients, colour = District)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Patient Counts by District Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Patients"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
top10_grps <- pharmacDistrict %>%
  count(TherapeuticGrp2, wt = NumDisps, name = "total_dispensings") %>%
  slice_max(total_dispensings, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(TherapeuticGrp2)

pharmacDistrict %>%
  filter(TherapeuticGrp2 %in% top10_grps) %>%
  group_by(District, TherapeuticGrp2) %>%
  summarise(total_dispensings = sum(NumDisps, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  
  mutate(
    TherapeuticGrp2 = factor(TherapeuticGrp2, levels = rev(top10_grps)),
    District = fct_reorder(District, total_dispensings, .fun = sum)
  ) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = TherapeuticGrp2, y = District, fill = total_dispensings)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", labels = scales::comma) + 
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Therapeutic Groups by District",
    x = "Therapeutic Group Level 2",
    y = "District",
    fill = "Total initial dispensings"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
  )

```

bins

### Part 2: Just Census Data

```{r}
census <- read.csv("census2023.csv", header = TRUE)
head(census)
```

```{r}
dim(census)
# 20 values with 29 variables.
# New Zealand is included, Capital and Coast and Hutt Valley are combined into one area (represents merger of the two districts in 2021)
```

```{r}
summary(census)
```

```{r}
# No missing data!
any(is.na(census))
```

```{r}
census_numeric <- census %>%
  filter(Area != "New Zealand") %>%
  select(where(is.numeric))

cor_matrix <- cor(census_numeric, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

ggcorrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  type = "lower",
  lab = FALSE,
  hc.order = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
area_summaries <- census %>%
  filter(Area != "New Zealand") %>%
  select(Area, where(is.numeric)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Area, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Area, Variable) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Value = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

top10_differentiating_vars <- census %>%
  filter(Area != "New Zealand") %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "CV") %>%
  slice_max(CV, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(Variable)

area_summaries %>%
  filter(Variable %in% top10_differentiating_vars) %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  mutate(Scaled_Value = scale(Mean_Value)[, 1]) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = top10_differentiating_vars),
    Area = fct_reorder(Area, Scaled_Value, .fun = sum)
  ) %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = Variable, y = Area, fill = Scaled_Value)) +
  geom_tile(linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "Relative Score\n(Z-Score)") +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Demographic Profiles in Districts",
    x = "Demographic",
    y = "District"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

```

### Part 3: Putting Them Together

```{r}
to_merge <- pharmac %>% 
  filter(District %in% c("Capital & Coast", "Hutt Valley"))

unchanged_data <- pharmac %>% 
  filter(!District %in% c("Capital & Coast", "Hutt Valley"))

merged_districts <- to_merge %>%
  group_by(YearDisp, TherapeuticGrp2) %>%
  summarise(
    NumDisps = sum(NumDisps, na.rm = TRUE),
    NumPpl = sum(NumPpl, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(District = "Capital, Coast and Hutt Valley") # Exact Census name

pharmac_clean <- bind_rows(unchanged_data, merged_districts)
```

```{r}
integrated_data <- pharmac_clean %>%
  filter(District != "New Zealand") %>%
  left_join(
    census %>% filter(Area != "New Zealand"), 
    by = c("District" = "Area")
  )

if ("Population" %in% colnames(integrated_data)) {
  integrated_data <- integrated_data %>%
    mutate(
      Dispensings_Per_1k = (NumDisps / Population) * 1000,
      Patients_Per_1k    = (NumPpl / Population) * 1000
    )
}
```

```{r}
head(integrated_data)
```

final attempt

```{r}
top10_med_groups <- integrated_data %>%
  group_by(TherapeuticGrp2) %>%
  summarise(Grand_Total_Patients = sum(NumPpl, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(Grand_Total_Patients, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(TherapeuticGrp2)

top10_integrated <- integrated_data %>%
  filter(TherapeuticGrp2 %in% top10_med_groups)
```

```{r}
district_demo_profiles <- top10_integrated %>%
  select(District, Patients_Per_1k, where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("Total_Population_Column", "YearDisp", "NumDisps", "NumPpl", "Dispensings_Per_1k"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(District, Patients_Per_1k), names_to = "Demographic_Variable", values_to = "Demographic_Value") %>%
  group_by(District, Demographic_Variable) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Patient_Rate = mean(Patients_Per_1k, na.rm = TRUE), Mean_Demo_Val = mean(Demographic_Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

top10_demo_correlations <- district_demo_profiles %>%
  group_by(Demographic_Variable) %>%
  summarise(Patient_Correlation = cor(Mean_Patient_Rate, Mean_Demo_Val, use = "complete.obs"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(abs(Patient_Correlation), n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(Demographic_Variable)

district_demo_profiles %>%
  filter(Demographic_Variable %in% top10_demo_correlations) %>%
  group_by(Demographic_Variable) %>%
  mutate(Scaled_Value = scale(Mean_Demo_Val)[, 1]) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Demographic_Variable = factor(Demographic_Variable, levels = top10_demo_correlations), District = fct_reorder(District, Scaled_Value, .fun = sum)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Demographic_Variable, y = District, fill = Scaled_Value)) +
  geom_tile(linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "Z-Score") +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Demographic Profiles in Districts", subtitle = "Ordered by correlation with Patient Rates", x = "Demographic Variable", y = "District") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9), panel.grid = element_blank())

```

```{r}
district_med_profiles <- top10_integrated %>%
  group_by(District, TherapeuticGrp2) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Patient_Rate = mean(Patients_Per_1k, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(District = fct_reorder(District, Mean_Patient_Rate, .fun = sum), TherapeuticGrp2 = fct_reorder(TherapeuticGrp2, Mean_Patient_Rate, .fun = sum))

ggplot(district_med_profiles, aes(x = TherapeuticGrp2, y = District, fill = Mean_Patient_Rate)) +
  geom_tile(linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", name = "Patients per 1k") +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Medication Patient Rates by District", x = "Therapeutic Group", y = "District") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9), panel.grid = element_blank())

```

```{r}
annual_demo_shifts <- top10_integrated %>%
  select(District, YearDisp, Patients_Per_1k, where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("Total_Population_Column", "NumDisps", "NumPpl", "Dispensings_Per_1k"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(District, YearDisp, Patients_Per_1k), names_to = "Demographic_Variable", values_to = "Demographic_Value") %>%
  filter(Demographic_Variable %in% top10_demo_correlations) %>%
  group_by(District, YearDisp, Demographic_Variable) %>%
  summarise(Annual_Patient_Rate = mean(Patients_Per_1k, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(District = fct_reorder(District, Annual_Patient_Rate, .fun = sum))

ggplot(annual_demo_shifts, aes(x = Demographic_Variable, y = District, fill = Annual_Patient_Rate)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", name = "Patients per 1k") +
  facet_wrap(~ YearDisp, ncol = 5) +
  labs(title = "Demographic Patient Rate Shifts Across Years", x = "Core Demographic Feature", y = "District") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7), panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}
# Aggregate granular medication rates per year
annual_med_shifts <- top10_integrated %>%
  group_by(District, YearDisp, TherapeuticGrp2) %>%
  summarise(Annual_Patient_Rate = mean(Patients_Per_1k, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(District = fct_reorder(District, Annual_Patient_Rate, .fun = sum), TherapeuticGrp2 = fct_reorder(TherapeuticGrp2, Annual_Patient_Rate, .fun = sum))

ggplot(annual_med_shifts, aes(x = TherapeuticGrp2, y = District, fill = Annual_Patient_Rate)) +
  geom_tile(linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "turbo", name = "Patients per 1k") +
  facet_wrap(~ YearDisp, ncol = 5) +
  labs(title = "Medication Patient Rate Shifts Across Years", x = "Therapeutic Group", y = "District") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 4), panel.grid = element_blank())

```
